message.content: Let me check the build.sh to understand how to build:

content:
build_dir=$WORK/build
mkdir -p ${build_dir}
pushd ${build_dir}
rm -rf ./*
if [[ $CFLAGS = *sanitize=memory* ]]; then
  extra_c_flags='-DAOM_MAX_ALLOCABLE_MEMORY=536870912'
else
  extra_c_flags='-DAOM_MAX_ALLOCABLE_MEMORY=1073741824'
fi
extra_c_flags+=' -DDO_RANGE_CHECK_CLAMP=1'
extra_cmake_flags=
if [[ $CFLAGS = *sanitize=memory* ]]; then
  extra_cmake_flags+="-DAOM_TARGET_CPU=generic"
fi
cmake $SRC/aom -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE='-O3 -g'   -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE='-O3 -g' -DCMAKE_LD_FLAGS_RELEASE='-O3 -g'   -DCONFIG_PIC=1 -DCONFIG_SCALABILITY=0 -DCONFIG_LOWBITDEPTH=1   -DCONFIG_AV1_ENCODER=0 -DENABLE_EXAMPLES=0 -DENABLE_DOCS=0 -DENABLE_TESTS=0   -DCONFIG_SIZE_LIMIT=1 -DDECODE_HEIGHT_LIMIT=12288 -DDECODE_WIDTH_LIMIT=12288   -DAOM_EXTRA_C_FLAGS="${extra_c_flags}"   -DAOM_EXTRA_CXX_FLAGS="${extra_c_flags}" ${extra_cmake_flags}
make -j$(nproc)
popd
$CC $CFLAGS -std=c99 -c   -I$SRC/aom   -I${build_dir}   $SRC/aom/common/ivfdec.c -o ${build_dir}/ivfdec.o
$CC $CFLAGS -std=c99 -c   -I$SRC/aom   -I${build_dir}   $SRC/aom/common/tools_common.c -o ${build_dir}/tools_common.o
fuzzer_src_name=av1_dec_fuzzer
fuzzer_modes=( '' '_threaded' )
for mode in "${fuzzer_modes[@]}"; do
  fuzzer_name=${fuzzer_src_name}${mode}
  $CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11     -DDECODE_MODE${mode}     -I$SRC/aom     -I${build_dir}     -Wl,--start-group     -lFuzzingEngine     $SRC/${fuzzer_src_name}.cc -o $OUT/${fuzzer_name}     ${build_dir}/libaom.a ${build_dir}/ivfdec.o ${build_dir}/tools_common.o     -Wl,--end-group
  cp $SRC/dec_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip $OUT/${fuzzer_name}_seed_corpus.zip
  cp $SRC/av1_dec_fuzzer.dict $OUT/${fuzzer_name}.dict
done
